name: Rechtspraak sample
source: Open Data van de Rechtspraak (Raad voor de rechtspraak)
licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication), as listed in the data.overheid.nl catalogue
method: scripts/prepare_rechtspraak.py: a seeded, balanced sample of 20 rulings per legal sub-area and year from the open-data API; rulings with one legal area only
transformations: scripts/clean_rechtspraak.py removes the echoes of court, court type and year from the text (ECLI codes, case numbers carrying the year, court names, generic court-type words, 'Zittingsplaats X', four-digit years), the same way for every ruling
no names are scrubbed: the text is the court's pseudonymised publication
every other column keeps its original value
embeddings: scripts/package_data_release.py: MarkSelles/dutch-minilm-l6-v2 (Apache-2.0), half precision, one row per ruling for `summary` and `ruling_excerpt`
caveat: Pseudonymised is not anonymous: residual personal data can remain in the text.
